messages:
Priya (AE): AcmePay asks if we can run a 2-week POC: their Wasm edge runtime (Wasmtime) will multiplex ~1k logical streams over a single websocket. Requirements: per-stream priority (gold/silver), function/tool calls returning structured JSON, and predictable latency. Any immediate blockers?
Jordan (SE): No blockers in principle. Two clarifying Qs: (1) are they expecting server-side separate sessions per stream for KV cache isolation? (2) do they need server push -> client notifications?
Priya (AE): They want isolated conversation state per logical stream (so yes to KV isolation). No server push for now, just request/response.
Tom (SDK): Notes from SDK side: multiplexing is supported but affects batching. We rely on contiguous token streams to batch effectively. For multiplex, include per-frame metadata headers like `x-rw-stream-id` and `x-rw-priority`. Minimal example proxy headers: ```
GET /v1/stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.com
Upgrade: websocket
x-rw-stream-id: <uuid>
x-rw-priority: gold
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
Client frames should tag messages with the stream-id so the backend can rehydrate separate KV caches.
Jordan (SE): Operational knobs: set `max_inflight_per_stream` (e.g., 3), `priority_weight` (gold=2, silver=1), and a `latency_slo_ms`. When a high-priority stream would exceed its SLO, route that stream to a smaller quantized model as fallback. Example config snippet we can share.
Elena (Security): Security requirements: mTLS between adapter and our ingestion endpoint, IP allowlist, and short-lived tokens with rotation (we recommend STS-style exchange). For PII-sensitive workflows, require dedicated VPC peering or Dedicated deployment. I'll attach SQA pack and SOC2 snippets.
Priya (AE): Pricing question: rough hosted cost for 1k concurrent streams, avg 30 tokens/sec, 6 hours/day for 10 business days? They want ballpark for comparing Hosted vs Dedicated.
Tom (SDK): Quick calc (hosted): per stream tokens/day = 30 * 3600 * 6 = 648,000 tokens. For 10 days = 6,480,000 tokens/stream. For 1k streams => 6.48e9 tokens. At hosted rate $0.00003/token => $194,400. If use q4f16-ish at $0.000008/token => $51,840. Caveats: prefix caching and batching reduce effective billed tokens; multiplexing might lower network overhead but can reduce batch sizes. Dedicated pricing/commits can materially reduce unit price — I'll work up a estimate table.
Jordan (SE): Suggest path: (1) run short warm-up with staging (validate headers and KV isolation), (2) measure effective batching ratio and token billing, (3) decide on Dedicated if cost projection exceeds budget. For POC, recommend hosted sandbox with dedicated pool (limited capacity) so they see realistic latency.
Priya (AE): Action list: Tom share Wasm adapter example + test harness; Jordan prepare Hosted vs Dedicated cost slide and routing policy examples; Elena assemble SQA + KMS notes. I'll schedule kickoff and draft the POC success criteria.
Tom (SDK): Pushed sample: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/tree/main/wasm/stream-muxer. Local test command:```bash
# run demo adapter
go run ./examples/wasm/stream-muxer/cmd --endpoint ws://staging.api.redwood.com/v1/stream --streams=50 --rate=30
```
Jordan (SE): I'll prepare a short experiment plan to measure: batching efficiency, KV cache hit-rate, latency p95 per-priority, and failover behavior when capacity constrained. Can join kickoff tomorrow 10am PT.
deploy-bot: examples/wasm/stream-muxer v0.3 deployed to staging-us-west-2 :rocket:
Priya (AE): Great, thanks. @Jordan please confirm meeting with AcmePay; I'll open the POC ticket and attach this thread and Elena's security checklist once available.
Jordan (SE): Meeting confirmed with AcmePay for tomorrow 10am PT.
Priya (AE): Closing loop for now.
